text:
PSC::tower_id
Description
The PSC::tower_id command gets the tower id or sets the tower id when
the optional is given.
Syntax
PSC
::
tower_id
PSC
::
tower_id
<
value
>
PSC::tower_id
retrieve the tower id
PSC::tower_id <name>
set the tower id
